candidates.entry_rule: Price breaks a multi-week range high on expanding volume, then pulls back to the broken level and holds.
candidates.exit_rule: Target at 2.2R prior-swing projection; stop below the reclaimed breakout level.
candidates.invalidation: Close back inside the prior range, or volume contracts below the 20-period average on the retest.
candidates.calc_note: Initial lot_step=1 was REJECTED by the calculator (zero_position_quantity) — crypto trades fractional; corrected to lot_step=0.001. Input corrected, output not overridden.

candidates.entry_rule: Liquid large-cap extends >2 sigma below a 20-day mean into prior support; enter on the first higher-low reclaim.
candidates.exit_rule: Target at the 20-day mean (~2.33R); stop below the support shelf.
candidates.invalidation: Support shelf breaks on a closing basis, or the reclaim fails within 2 sessions.
candidates.calc_note: All calculator flags passed on first run.

candidates.entry_rule: Post-consolidation range expansion: enter on a decisive breakout bar closing beyond the compressed range with rising true range.
candidates.exit_rule: Target 2.5R measured-move; stop at the opposite side of the expansion bar.
candidates.invalidation: Price re-enters the consolidation range, or the expansion bar's extreme is retraced within 1 session.
candidates.calc_note: All calculator flags passed on first run.

journal_schema.note: Every entry/skip/exit writes a gateway entry. Skips and losses mandatory. mode always 'shadow' while LIVE_MODE=False.
